claims.quote: I had written both times down the way I always did, as if ink could fix an angle of the world.
claims.value: timestamps and records events in notebook

claims.quote:
2:00 a.m. — footsteps above.
3:12 a.m. — footsteps above.
The next morning I climbed up the narrow ladder to the attic with a torch and my notebook in my breast pocket. 9:14 a.m. — attic.
Cold light came through the gable and the whole place smelled of dust and old varnish.
The trapdoor had a crescent of white on the hinge: damp chalk smudges, the chalk itself soft to the touch as if it had been pressed and rubbed minutes, not years, ago.
claims.value: damp chalk smudges on trapdoor hinge; chalk tacky to touch

claims.quote: A jar on a low crate wore pale handprints around its rim where someone had held it; the powder on the prints still felt faintly tacky when I brushed at it with a fingertip.
claims.value: handprints in chalk powder around jar rim; powder tacky

claims.quote: I moved a tea tin that had been balanced like an afterthought on the central joist and there, under its dented lid, the doll lay on its side.
claims.value: beneath dented tea tin on central joist

claims.quote: It had one glass eye gone; the socket stared with an empty glaze. A braided ribbon was knotted to its wrist and a smear of dried mud darkened the hem of its dress.
claims.value: missing one eye; braided ribbon on wrist; dried mud smear on hem

claims.quote: Along the northern eaves I found the diary wedged tight under a beam where the rafters met the floor.
claims.value: wedged under northern eaves beam where rafters meet floor

claims.quote: Short entries, dates in a child’s hand; one page had a drawing of a toy with a bent wheel that looked, at a glance, like the broken toy in the photograph I had opened in the locket.
claims.value: childish dated entries; drawing of toy with bent wheel matching sepia photo toy

claims.quote: At the back a page had been torn out and the torn corner folded back into the lining like a secret.
claims.value: page torn out and folded into the back lining

claims.quote: Three boards from the trapdoor the floor was slightly springy. I levered the loose plank and the edge came up with a greyed sigh.
claims.value: loose plank three boards from trapdoor

claims.quote: The cavity beneath held a narrow bundle of papers and envelopes the size of a child's palm; beneath them the subfloor bore a dark, stubborn stain.
claims.value: bundle of papers and envelopes (child's palm sized)

claims.quote: The stain was dry when I touched it — a dark patch that smelled faintly of iron and old cloth, as if something had bled and then been left to the dust.
claims.value: dark dry stain; smell of iron and old cloth; not analysed

claims.quote: The joists carried the exact cadence of footfalls into the bedroom below.
claims.value: thin joists and hollow cavities transmit attic footfalls into rooms below

claims.quote: And the smear along the locket's rim stayed unexplained, a dark comma I had not yet read.
9:48 a.m. — I wrote the time and the feeling: a small presence, patient and precise, and an anxiety that had the shape of a clock hand moving steadily toward something I could not yet name.
claims.value: feels a small, patient presence; rising precise anxiety

promises.promise: Reader is owed verification of the photograph's date and the full provenance of the sepia photo inside the locket (matching to obj-sepia-photo).
promises.quote: The bent toy in the picture and the child's scrawl in the diary matched close enough that I could not dismiss the likeness.
